Vulnerabilities affecting end-of-life/end-of-service products are in scope. The following categories of Samsung Products are in scope: Internet-connected home appliances, B2C product (smart TV, smart monitor, soundbar, and projector), and B2B products (digital signage, interactive display, and kiosk).
